whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Annapurna Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 4.0★ reviews with over 100 happy diners in Bihta, but you didn't have a dedicated mobile website for online table bookings and food menu viewing.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering/table booking, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/annapurna

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Annapurna Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first menu browsing, direct WhatsApp table bookings, and local directions right here in Bihta. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
